description: This file is a shell script used for testing the migration of ref storage backends in a git repository. It contains functions for performing ref migrations, verifying the outcomes, and a series of test cases validating different scenarios of repository migration between ref formats such as 'files' and 'reftable'.

methods.name: print_all_reflog_entries
methods.description: Prints all reflog entries for the main refstore of a given repository, iterating through reflogs and outputting their entries.

methods.name: test_migration
methods.description: Performs migration of references in a given repository to a specified format and verifies correctness by comparing expected and actual refs and reflogs, with options to skip reflog verification.
